# A `var` declared in a window body is that window's state, the way a
# component's `var` is the component's. The checker leaves it as a top-level
# LocalVar in the body and passHoistState is what makes the two the same shape;
# before that, no target implemented the shape at all.
#
# It only looked implemented on the four non-html targets, because the
# initializer still appeared in the output -- as a local of the render function,
# reset every frame, assigned from a model field nothing declared. bubbletea
# emitted Go that does not compile, android Kotlin naming an undeclared `n`,
# and html emitted no state and no binding whatsoever.
#
# So every assertion below names the *qualified* read, not the initializer: a
# bare `n` is exactly what each of these looked like when it was broken. The
# same program is written twice, once as a window and once as a component, and
# each target has to produce the same shape for both.

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=h-win win.sngl
grep 'var state = \{ n: 0 \}' h-win/index.html
grep 'state.n = state.n \+ 1' h-win/index.html
grep 'textContent = String\(state.n\)' h-win/index.html
! grep '= n \+ 1' h-win/index.html

# The component form is the reference: html emits the same script for both,
# differing only in the generated-from header and the title the window declares.
sngl generate --platform=html --lang=none --out=h-comp comp.sngl
grep 'var state = \{ n: 0 \}' h-comp/index.html
grep 'state.n = state.n \+ 1' h-comp/index.html
grep 'textContent = String\(state.n\)' h-comp/index.html

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=bt win.sngl
grep 'm.n = \(m.n \+ 1\)' bt/model.go
grep 'func \(m \*Model\) __focusNext\(\)' bt/model.go
grep 'm.__focusNext\(\)' bt/model.go
! grep '^	n = ' bt/model.go

sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=fy win.sngl
grep 'm.n = \(m.n \+ 1\)' fy/model.go

sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=go --out=gt win.sngl
grep 'm.n = \(m.n \+ 1\)' gt/model.go

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=an win.sngl
grep 'var n by remember \{ mutableStateOf\(0\) \}' an/MainScreen.kt
grep 'n = \(n \+ 1\)' an/MainScreen.kt

-- win.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"

window #home(title="Home", href="/") {
    var n = 0
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
        button #inc(text="+", @click { n = n + 1 })
    }
}

-- comp.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main {
    var n = 0
    vbox {
        text(value="{n}")
        button #inc(text="+", @click { n = n + 1 })
    }
}
